author: HeadStrongPride
quote: An absolute masterpiece, giving you full control over player actions. You can join the Stormcloaks or the Empire, you can join the Assassin's Guild or destroy it.  This game is addictively fun. I've put in literally over a thousand hours play time and enjoyed every moment.
game_title: The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim Special Edition

author: HeadStrongPride
quote:
Terribly glitchy and a lot of bugs. 

The character of Lucia is just awful.  Instantly dislike her.  When you play as Jason, your goal is to appease her, buy her things, but when you play as Lucia, she does nothing for Jason.  

Story is forced.  You have no option to ditch or kill Lucia.  

Game mechanics aren't great. Fist fighting is clunky and awkward.   The story dictates your actions, like you can't steal cars in certain area and can't massacre NPCs in others.  

Just a huge disappointment.
